_comment: Template for node ml/coaching_eval.mjs --labels. Copy to ml/outputs/coaching-labels.json (ignored) and fill in. Times are ms on the pose-cache clock (decoded video PTS). label: no-issue | torso-swing | upper-arm-drift | swinging | incomplete-rom. issueStartMs (optional) is when the sustained issue first becomes visible inside the window. reviewStatus becomes independently-reviewed only after a second person checked the windows.
